highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 3.119.5 backports Apple 26.0 TFM support and a WinUI Projection fix from the v4 line.

bullets.lead: Apple 26.0 library TFM and unversioned app TFMs backported
bullets.detail: Brings the Apple target-framework realignment from the v4 line back to 3.119.x, so apps built against Apple 26.0 SDKs keep working without upgrading to v4.

bullets.lead: WinUI Projection DLL not found for .NET 9 consumers
bullets.detail: Fixes a missing native projection assembly that caused WinUI apps targeting .NET 9 to fail at runtime.

contributor_summaries.drasticactions: Backported Apple 26.0 library and unversioned app TFM support
